name: short-slide-down
title: Short Slide Down
description: Words drop in from above and stack into a centered multi-line composition.
useWhen: A multi-word headline should build its layout visibly, each word stacking into a composed block.
A fast entrance that still feels structured, with vertical motion and no outgoing text.
avoidWhen: You are swapping between two text values: use shared-axis-y.
A single word or short phrase does not benefit from stacking: use scale-down-fade or soft-blur-in.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Headline whose words stack one per line.

variables.label: Entry offset
variables.description: How far above its row each new word starts.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Type size in pixels. Larger text shrinks so the stack fits the frame.
